patches.title: Open Surface Priority Clean
patches.principle: Search countertops and dining tables first for cleanable objects; avoid opening closed containers until open surfaces are exhausted.
patches.when_to_apply: When beginning a clean task and target is not visible.

patches.title: Direct Sink After Pickup
patches.principle: After picking up the object to clean, go directly to the sinkbasin without any detours.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding the target object and needing to clean it.

patches.title: Immediate Post-Clean Placement
patches.principle: After cleaning, go directly to the destination and place the object. Do not perform any other actions.
patches.when_to_apply: After the clean action is completed.
